blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine men’s baseball team’s bid to reach the Super Round of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games suffered a big blow after a 15-8 loss to China on Tuesday at Okazaki Chuo Sogo Park Baseball Stadium. Starting pitcher Amiel de Guzman was roughed up for six runs in the second inning before the Philippines’ comeback attempt was thwarted after it surrendered five runs in the fifth, following run that cut the deficit to 7-3. All the Philippines could do the rest of the way was avoid defeat via a 10-run mercy rule as it fell to 1-1 in Group A with […]...
